title: tc-response-examples
description: An endpoint's example responses, one tab per status, each with its meaning, headers and a pretty-printed body to copy.

examples.description: The example responses, one tab each, in the order given

status.description: The tab showing, by its status ("200"); the first when empty or unknown. Changed by the tabs unless a tc-status-change listener calls preventDefault()

mediaType.description: The body's media type; the status's first when empty or not among its bodies. Changed by the select unless a tc-media-type-change listener calls preventDefault()

maxHeight.description: The tallest the body gets before it scrolls, in px; 0 for no limit

labels.description: Rename any of the words, over the defaults

label.description: The tab's words after the code; the standard reason phrase when left out

description.description: What the response means, in a sentence or two

body.description: The body, for a single media type

mediaType.description: The body's media type; application/json when left out

bodies.description: Bodies in several media types; wins over `body`

ResponseExampleBody.description: One body of a response, in one media type
